en-gemini-autonoe.hyp: Here's what happens when you ship an issue.  Ship reads the ticket, opens a fresh Git work tree, and writes a failing test first.  Then it makes the test pass, runs the full gate, and opens a pull request.  A reviewer bot leaves comments on the diff.  Ship answers each thread, pushes one fix per round, and waits for CI to turn green.  Only then does it merge, and the branch is cleaned up for you.
